help.title: Getting started
help.body:
# Getting started

ActionTracker helps you organize work across projects and disciplines. Use the left icon rail to switch **perspectives** — each one swaps both the left panel and the main panel.

Start in **Actions**: expand a project, then a discipline, and click an action to see its detail.

help.title: Tree navigation
help.body:
# Tree navigation (Actions)

The left panel is a read-only navigation hierarchy: **Project → Discipline → Action**.

- Click a chevron (▾ / ▸) to expand or collapse a group.
- Click an action (or its **✎**) to open it inline in the main panel — every field is directly editable.
- Click a discipline's **+** to add a new action.
- Projects, disciplines, statuses and member names are added or edited only in **Settings** — the create card and inline editor let you pick from those lists, never add to them.

help.title: Perspectives
help.body:
# Perspectives

Each icon is a perspective that defines both panels:

- **Actions**: tree + detail
- **Projects**: list + dashboard
- **Disciplines**: list + cross-project breakdown
- **Reports**: types + chart
- **Search**: saved filters + results
- **Settings / Help**: sections + articles

All list values — **Projects**, **Disciplines**, **Statuses** and **Members** (names) — are managed only in **Settings**.

help.title: Import / Export
help.body:
# Import / Export

**Quick Actions** (right panel) holds the main buttons: **Save Actions** / **Save Settings** write `action.json` / `setup.json`, **Export** opens the Word/Excel drawer, plus Import, Layout and **Help**. The top-bar **⋯** menu mirrors these and adds Create, data folder and theme — so they stay reachable even when the right panel is hidden or on narrow screens.

- **Save Actions** writes the current dataset as `action.json`.
- **Save Settings** writes the UI configuration (brand, labels, default view, help, reports, filters) as `setup.json`.

On Chromium both pickers open in the data folder you set; elsewhere they download.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.body:
# Keyboard shortcuts

- **Ctrl/Cmd + 1…7** — jump to a perspective.
- **Ctrl/Cmd + S** — Save Actions (action.json) · **Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + S** — Save Settings (setup.json).
- **Ctrl/Cmd + E** — open Export · **Ctrl/Cmd + ,** — Settings.
- **Enter** — commit an inline rename in Settings.
- **Esc** — cancel an inline edit, close a modal or a mobile drawer.
